condition.help: Hold the temperature fixed on this entity. The solver freezes these nodes: no conduction, advection or reaction heating will move them. Requires heat conduction or heat advection to be enabled in the calculation data. Do not apply this and a convective heat boundary to the same entity - the two thermal boundary sets must be disjoint.

value.help: Absolute temperature held at these nodes.

Curve from the Time functions container that drives this temperature in time. Constant holds the value above for the whole calculation. A prescribed temperature history is applied whether or not heat transport is enabled, since it also drives the pressure through the ideal gas law.
